text:
People can’t seriously believe he didn’t have a PR campaign for the Ballon d’Or. 

He absolutely did. Harry Kane’s name was brought up so many times throughout the year, and I saw it all over social media. Reddit, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, you name it.

 A lot of it was more subtle but his name was definitely being pushed in the media.

As a casual football fan who doesn’t support any particular European club, I found it pretty obvious. What surprises me is how many people on Reddit act like they’re experts at reading media narratives while insisting he had absolutely no PR backing. 

Maybe I’m the one missing something here, but at this point I’m genuinely wondering if some of these comments are even coming from real people or if I’m just seeing a bunch of bots repeating the same thing.
